register_fbnetv3_models: import this module to register FBNetV3 model architectures into the MODEL_ARCH registry
register_fbnetv3_gpu_models: import this module to register GPU-optimized FBNetV3 model architectures into the MODEL_ARCH registry
register_fbnetv3_i8f_models: import this module to register int8-friendly FBNetV3 variants via mdu.get_i8f_models
review_fbnetv3_architecture: review the FBNetV3_A through FBNetV3_G and FBNetV3_20G model block definitions
review_fbnetv3_gpu_architecture: review the GPU-optimized FBNetV3_A_GPU through FBNetV3_G_GPU fused MB model definitions
